_comment: Owner-reported, 2026-10-21: 'dragoon ms sells for likely 6500 now so 4k is too low and 3k is lowest'. Recorded as two sightings because that is what was actually stated — a typical price and a floor. NOT imported automatically: computeMarketStats needs MIN_BAND_OBSERVATIONS (3) before it will publish a band, and inventing a third to clear the threshold is precisely what this collection exists to prevent.
note: Owner-reported typical asking price. Hard Metal System Dragoon MS — NOT Strata/Gaia Dragoon MS, which are different beys on their own leaves.
Owner-reported floor. The seeded Hard Metal System generation band put the median at 3999, which the owner states is too low for this specific bey.
